Package bg.tu_varna.ks.command.files

Class AppData

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.ks.command.files.AppData
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileHandler
public class AppData extends Object implements FileHandler
Singleton responsible for reading and writing calendar data in an XML file via JAXB.

The class holds a reference to the currently opened file and exposes methods to load, save, and close it. It implements the FileHandler contract by providing load(File) and unload().

In addition to managing the "opened document", it also offers the ability to read an external calendar file without making it active - see readCalendar(File), used by the merge and findslotwith commands.

      public Calendar readCalendar(File file) throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException, FileNotFoundException

    • load

      public void load(File file) throws FileNotFoundException, jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Loads a calendar file and makes it active.

      If the file does not exist or is empty, it is created and the calendar is initialized with an empty event collection. In all other cases, the contents are read and applied to the Calendar.

      Specified by:
      load in interface FileHandler
      Parameters:
      file - the file to load
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if the file cannot be opened
      jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException - on deserialization error

    • unload

      public void unload() throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Writes the current state back to the active file.
